title: Microsoft Edge: allow Microsoft 365 authentication pop-ups in work profiles
summary: The policy paths, registry settings and default behaviour are supported. Hold for the Graph call in the prose: its printed path omits the required beta version. The Intune sentence also needs to name the authentication policy explicitly, and the rollout discussion should acknowledge Microsoft's existing Stable-channel release notes.
